_source: DOMINION D17 (BUILD_SLICES.md). Rules: Part 5 §7 (finishing the game: every region owned, none lost at the moment the last is Taken, or the Goal fully achieved; the ending screen shows the Empire Map, the Ledger graph across all days, every crew member's journey and the Hero beaten in each region), Part 0 §6.1 Q4 (Charters unlock after one finished run), old Evil Mode Part 23 §9.3 = Kice answer 9 (account rewards in full, by how far the run got; no ending pays more than another) and §10 (no line calls the Boss a winner, a loser, good, evil, a villain or a hero). No mockup draws this page: it is made of the round-4 parts of s7 (the Ledger graph) and s10 (the region cards).
goalEndsNote: Part 5 §7 names Clean Slate and Everlasting as Goals that end the run on their own. Every other Goal takes its region and the run goes on to the next one.

screen.title: THE EMPIRE
screen.every: Every region in the run answers to {team}.
screen.goalWhy: The Goal is done. Nothing in the next region could add to it.
screen.otherEndings: This Goal's other endings: {list}. Their conditions aren't tracked yet; this run is read as its first.
screen.graphEmpty: The books start on run day {day}.
screen.crewNone: Nobody stayed. The Boss did this alone.
screen.payNote: The account pays this run's ordinary rewards in full, the same for every ending. They are added when the books close.
screen.box: {who} looks over the books one last time. {line}
boxLines: Every day is in here. Even the rainy one.
It started with one warehouse and a leaking roof.
The ledger doesn't say what it felt like. It says what it cost.
screen.charters: The Charters are open on the next run's Boss page (C).

collapse._rule: Part 5 §8: Collapse is the HQ destroyed (every room inside ruined) and ₽ below 0 and no districts held. Never a game over (Kice).
lines: The HQ is ash, the books are red and not one street answers to {team}.
Morning finds the Boss in a new warehouse in the same region, with {name} and ₽1,000.
collapse.alone: Morning finds the Boss in a new warehouse in the same region, alone, with ₽1,000.
collapse.kept: Held regions elsewhere stay held. The days keep counting.
